prompt:
Use case: game asset modeling style-target sheet.
Create a polished LANDSCAPE reference sheet for THREE INDIVIDUAL Battle Cities environment models, NOT a map layout. Use the three supplied existing stage concepts for art direction only. Turn their charming buildings into convincing detailed-but-readable, chunky beveled LOW-POLY TOY 3D building models. Bright clean arcade color, warm cream stucco/stone, rich blue roofs, small coral/orange accents, restrained silver hardware, navy recesses, modest warm window/utility-light accents. No grunge, painted flat stripes pretending to be geometry, simple colored cubes, photoreal architecture or excessive microdetail.

The sheet has exactly THREE COLUMNS, each showing the SAME building in two matching views: a large elevated front-left THREE-QUARTER view above and a TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP view below. Light neutral warm cream background, thin subtle footprint outlines under models, soft short grounding shadows only. Columns labeled with these exact concise labels:
'HARBOR WAREHOUSE • 3×2'
'RANGER CABIN • 2×2'
'FACTORY WORKSHOP • 3×2'

Column 1: broad low warehouse with a cobalt BLUE BARREL-VAULT ROOF, actual rounded arch profile built from several broad faceted curved panels, off-white masonry body with strongly inset navy roll-up loading door on the south/front face, small gold utility lamps, little silver low-profile ridge vent. The curved roof and a small inset side service nook must produce a convincing toy building silhouette. All geometry, roof, foundation and trim inside a 3-wide x 2-deep rectangular footprint, max height 1.25 relative units.
Column 2: compact 2x2 ranger cabin, steep but low BLUE GABLE ROOF with broad ridge cap, cream plaster and warm timber wall posts, modest chimney, warm framed small window, inset entrance/porch, no projecting balcony. Silhouette differs clearly from warehouse. Max height 1.15 units.
Column 3: 3x2 industrial workshop with a BLUE STEPPED SAWTOOTH ROOF containing two broad short sloping segments and two narrow cyan-grey skylight bands, squat cream/grey factory walls, inset closed shutter, orange corner/door trim and two SHORT silver roof vents. Max height 1.3 units. Not tall smokestacks.

All roofs occupy at most 90-96% of their rectangle and every protrusion remains INSIDE the assigned footprint. All three front doors face SOUTH (down in top view). The top views must have no perspective taper and accurately show the same modeled roof shapes as the three-quarter views. Render at consistent relative scale, so 3x2 buildings appear wider than the 2x2 cabin. Show obvious bevel thickness and clean sculpted volumes, subtle material variation, a small number of architectural details sized to remain readable at small game scale. Use an upper-left light, smooth highlights with faceted geometry. Do not add a pavement diorama, streets, unrelated props, signs, lettering on buildings, new gameplay elements, tanks, eagle, brick/steel wall assets, borders or UI. This is a modeling target, not a generic concept painting. Output one high-resolution landscape sheet with complete uncropped models and tidy legible labels.
role: Agent-selected representative style target; color, silhouette and material reference; exact dimensions come from manifest.
visualReview: accepted: differentiated sculpted roof forms, layered walls, restrained detail and readable palette. Final modeling sheets refine view and footprint constraints.
